verdict.stance: Overweight / Near-Net-Cash Gold & Copper Producer (BB Stable)
verdict.summary: Harmony Gold delivered record FY26 (ended Jun-26) revenue of R99.2bn ($5.88bn, +34% YoY), Adj FCF of R17.1bn ($1.01bn, +54% YoY), and near-zero 0.02x net leverage ($526.1m cash, $52m net debt). Its Sep-26 $500m 2031 convertible bond pre-funds Eva Copper and CSA copper diversification within Fitch's <1.0x net leverage guardrail.

positives: Exceptional FY26 cash generation ($1.01bn Adj FCF, +54% YoY) with 0.02x net leverage and $1.04bn liquidity.
Strategic copper diversification via CSA Mine integration and Eva Copper project reduces pure SA gold exposure.
Fitch 'BB' Stable rating anchored by strict <1.0x net debt/EBITDA financial policy.
negatives: Aging, deep-level South African underground gold mines face structural wage, Eskom power, and AISC inflation.
Large multi-year Eva Copper (Australia) and Wafi-Golpu (PNG) project capex execution risk.
High sensitivity to spot gold and copper price pullbacks.

background.business_overview: South Africa's largest gold producer expanding into tier-1 copper (CSA Australia, Eva Copper, Wafi-Golpu PNG).
background.asset_perimeter: SA underground & surface operations (Mponeng, Moab Khotsong, Tshepong), Hidden Valley (PNG), CSA Copper (Australia).
background.ownership_governance: JSE/NYSE listed (HAR / HMY); African Rainbow Minerals strategic ~12% shareholder.

recent_drivers: FY26 (Jun-26): Revenue R99.24bn ($5.88bn, +34%), Adj FCF R17.1bn ($1.01bn, +54%), net debt $52m (0.02x).
